We use exact match accuracy and ROUGE-1 F1 score (token-level) to evaluate the output of the generation models and to evaluate human agreement (Section 3.4).
We performed a crowdsourced annotation procedure to collect additional correct answers for each blank in the validation and test sets. We use Amazon Mechanical Turk (AMT) for the annotation.
guideline: Workers were presented a video clip along with the corresponding masked caption. They were then asked to fill in the blank with a noun phrase. We also asked annotators to provide answers in a confidence-descending order (the first answer should be the most natural one to the annotator).
